verdict.rationale: Featurebase supports a unified inbox across in-app, Slack, Discord, and email, plus webhooks/integrations for automation, which covers chat and support-ticket capture. However, there is no evidence of ingesting or extracting feedback from sales call transcripts or calls-specific integrations (e.g., Gong, Zoom, CRM call logs). Missing for 10: explicit sales-call capture/integration evidence, automatic feedback extraction/tagging pipeline from call transcripts, and independent confirmation of this workflow.
